title: Dependency Resolution Flow
interaction_flow: Installer → Installer: run() — gc_disable(), check lock/update flags
Installer → Installer: createRepositorySet(true, platformRepo, aliases) → RepositorySet
Installer → RepositorySet: addRepository(repo) [for each remote repo, incl. ComposerRepository]
Installer → Installer: createRequest(fixedRootPackage, platformRepo, lockedRepository) → Request
Installer → Request: fixPackage(platformPackage) [for each platform package]
Installer → Request: requireName(packageName, constraint) [root requires + dev requires]
Installer → Request: setUpdateAllowList(updateAllowList, transitiveMode) [if partial update]
Installer → RepositorySet: createPool(request, io, eventDispatcher, poolOptimizer, ...) → Pool
RepositorySet → PoolBuilder: new PoolBuilder(stabilities, flags, aliases, ...)
PoolBuilder → ComposerRepository: loadPackages(packageMap) [lazy load from remote]
Installer → Solver: new Solver(policy, pool, io)
Solver → RuleWatchGraph: new RuleWatchGraph(); insert(RuleWatchNode(rule)) for each rule
Solver → Solver: runSat() [DPLL-style SAT resolution with backtracking]
Solver → LockTransaction: new LockTransaction(pool, presentMap, fixedPackagesMap, decisions)
Installer → Installer: extractDevPackages(lockTransaction, platformRepo, aliases, policy)
Installer → ArrayRepository: new ArrayRepository([]); addPackage(pkg) for non-dev packages
Installer → RepositorySet: createRepositorySet(true, platformRepo, aliases) → RepositorySet2
Installer → Solver: new Solver(policy, pool2, io)
Installer → Installer: doInstall(localRepo) [if update=false, install from lock]
Installer → Installer: createRepositorySet(false, platformRepo, [], lockedRepository) → RepositorySet
Installer → Installer: createRequest(fixedRootPackage, platformRepo, lockedRepository) → Request
Installer → Request: fixLockedPackage(package) [for each locked package]
Installer → Request: requireName(platformPackage, constraint) [root platform requires]
Installer → Solver: solve(request, filter) → lockTransaction [verify platform compat]
Installer → InstallationManager: execute operations from lockTransaction
key_relationships: Installer composes RepositoryManager (manages remote repos incl. ComposerRepository)
Installer creates RepositorySet per run (not stored as field)
Installer creates Request per solve cycle via createRequest()
Installer creates Solver per solve cycle
Solver depends_on Pool (package lookup), PolicyInterface (version selection), RuleSetGenerator
LockTransaction holds Decisions + Pool reference; exposes getOperations(), setNonDevPackages(), getNewLockPackages()
Request holds fixedPackages map, requireNames list, updateAllowList
RootPackageInterface (fixedRootPackage) is a stripped clone of package (setRequires([]), setDevRequires([]))
important_notes: doUpdate() runs SAT twice: once for all deps (main solve), once for non-dev only (extractDevPackages) to separate dev/non-dev lock entries
doInstall() also runs a lightweight SAT solve to verify the lock file is compatible with current platform — it does NOT re-resolve versions
createRequest() fixes root package + all platform packages so SAT solver cannot remove/update them
PoolBuilder lazily loads packages from ComposerRepository (HTTP calls) when building Pool
Solver uses DPLL SAT with unit propagation (propagate()), conflict analysis (analyze()), and learning (learnedPool)
SolverProblemsException thrown with exit code ERROR_DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_FAILED (2) on unresolvable deps
GC is disabled at start of run() for performance during large SAT solving sessions
PolicyInterface (DefaultPolicy) selects preferred package versions among candidates satisfying constraints
FilterListPoolFilter / SecurityAdvisoryPoolFilter can remove packages from Pool before solving
